blurb: Bear Mountain Golf Course is a 9-hole, par 35 course located at 7,000 feet elevation in the San Bernardino Mountains. It offers a true alpine setting with Ponderosa pines and mountaintop vistas. The course is suitable for all skill levels and ages.
extraNote: Green fees due on day of tee time prior to playing; prices subject to change · Cancellations up to 3 days prior eligible for refund; within 3 days result in Activity Change Voucher; same-day cancellations or no-shows forfeit payment
